headline: Local Tea Stall Owner Confirms Secret Diplomatic Negotiations Actually Happened Over Two Cutting Chais and a Plate of Pakoras
body:
Ramesh Gupta, who has operated a roadside tea stall near the capital’s administrative hub for twenty-two years, has put to rest all global speculation regarding the recent high-level diplomatic visits by confirming that all major geopolitical agreements were finalized at his wooden counter. According to Gupta, the alleged secretive movements of high-ranking foreign intelligence officials were simply part of a standard lunch break involving light conversation, excessive sugar, and a heated debate over the best way to keep onions crispy.

“They didn't come here to discuss destabilizing regimes or classified intel,” explained Gupta while expertly frothing milk into a small glass. “They spent forty minutes complaining about the humidity and asking if I could add extra ginger to their tea. One man in a very expensive suit even tried to negotiate a bulk discount for a third plate of samosas, which I politely declined because the inflation on vegetable oil is quite real, regardless of what the central bank says.”

Global analysts remain stunned by the admission, noting that the ‘secretive visits’ described in international news reports match the exact timestamp of Gupta’s peak afternoon rush. The tea stall operator maintains that while the visitors appeared to be exchanging sensitive encrypted data, they were, in fact, just trying to locate a working Wi-Fi signal to check their fantasy cricket scores.

“I’ve hosted everyone from junior clerks to international envoys,” Gupta added, wiping down his table with a damp cloth. “At the end of the day, no one is above the common struggle of waiting for their order to arrive while a stray dog stares at their snack. If they were plotting a geopolitical shift, it certainly didn't happen while my stove was still heating the water.”
caption: Forget the geopolitical summits—the real decisions are happening at the local corner tea shop. ☕️🇮🇳 #Diplomacy #ChaiTime #GlobalAffairs #BreakingNews (satire)
igHook: Would you trust a plate of pakoras to keep the world's secrets safe?
